title: test(types): stop authoring the retired addRecord.mode / formView in two spec-alignment tests
body:
Fixes #13308
Clause-②: no

## What

objectstack-ai/objectstack#24970 retired `addRecord.mode` and `addRecord.formView` (`retiredKey()` tombstones). Two `@object-ui/types` tests still authored both keys on typed values, which is what turns objectstack's hourly Spec Shape Gate red (four `TS2322`s). Test-only change:

- `packages/types/src/__tests__/p2-spec-exports.test.ts`: the `AddRecordConfig` value keeps `enabled` and `position` only; the test name "should validate a full AddRecordConfig" now says what it checks ("with enabled and position").
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts`: the `ListViewSchema.addRecord` value keeps `enabled` and `position`; the `schema.addRecord?.mode` assertion is dropped.
- `.changeset/13308-add-record-retired-keys.md`: empty frontmatter (releases nothing). `check-changeset-presence` asked for it, because files under `packages/types/src` count as that package's source.

No source file changes. `.objectstack-sha` does not move. Outside tests, nothing in the tree authors or reads `addRecord.mode` / `addRecord.formView` (`git grep`). The only other mentions are prose: CHANGELOGs, `plugin-list` registration description text, a parity-ledger note string.

## Evidence (head `562f56cc00`)

- At the pin (`06cab48`): `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` exited 0.
- Against a spec built from objectstack `main` `28c9a2cb66` (that main already contains `fde7456352`, `merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0): I built and packed `@objectstack/spec` in a separate objectstack worktree, then put it into this worktree's install with `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs inject`, the gate's own wiring (32 consumers re-pointed). `type-check` exited 0.
- Control leg on the same injected install: I restored the two test files from `2794254099` (pre-fix main), and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exited 2 with exactly the gate's four diagnostics, `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts(184,9)`, `(185,9)` and `p2-spec-exports.test.ts(143,9)`, `(144,9)`: `TS2322 Type 'string' is not assignable to type '{ '[REMOVED] Key retired: ...': never; }'`. The trap then restored both files with `git checkout HEAD --`. `git diff HEAD` came back empty, and both blob hashes match HEAD.
- vitest (`--maxWorkers=1`): the two edited files passed 59/59. The three tests that name them (`page-node-type-contract`, `phase2-schemas`, `related-list-filter-rule-array-10199`) passed 51/51. I ran no whole-directory test locally; `packages/types` in full is declared to CI.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 2 changed `.ts` files gave 0 errors and 0 warnings (2 files per `--format json`). The repo config has no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change any untouched file's result.
- Pre-tsc battery: all exited 0. That covers phantom-deps, self-import, unreferenced-sources, doc-example-readers, handler-key-reads, side-effects-array, element-data-source-declaration, spec-symbols, action-forward-parity, designer-field-key-parity, icon-record-names, i18n-keys, i18n-drift, i18n-designer-parity, control-bytes, check-hand-rolled-comment-mask, check-changeset-fixed, changeset-presence, changeset-claims, changeset-no-major and pending-changeset-literals.
- `check:spec-floors` exited 1 with `no-artifact` because the workspace was not built. That is NOT MEASURED, not a red.

## Acceptance notes

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#25055's registry entry (objectstack PR #25091, open, not merged when this was written) lists these four diagnostics as `known`. Once this lands, that entry matches nothing and is deleted when #13308 closes.
